settings.p_human: each item's detector score from data/indomain/deleak, used as a continuous value
settings.chance_firing_more_human: over every pair of one firing and one non-firing item, the share of pairs where the firing item has the higher p_human (a tie counts half). 0 to 1: 0.5 means no relation, above 0.5 the feature leans human, below 0.5 it leans AI. Equals the AUC of firing against p_human. 'within_format' pairs items only from the same format; 'pooled' pairs any two items.
settings.leans: human if the 95% interval of chance_firing_more_human_within_format is entirely above 0.5, ai if entirely below, otherwise no clear relation
settings.quintiles: items ranked by p_human within their own format and cut into 5 equal groups; the first group has the lowest p_human (most AI-like)
settings.ci: 95% percentile interval over a doc-level bootstrap; docs resampled within each format x source cell of the sampling design (source is not used otherwise)
